claim: Wine is a compatibility layer for running Windows applications on Linux; 11.0 is the stable branch in 2026 and AppDB is the compatibility database to check first.
quote: Wine (originally an acronym for "Wine Is Not an Emulator") is a compatibility layer capable of running Windows applications on several POSIX-compliant operating systems, such as Linux, macOS, & BSD.

claim: WineHQ publishes Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze/Garbage rating definitions, so an app's viability can be triaged before committing effort.
VMware Workstation Pro is free for personal, educational and commercial use, downloadable from Broadcom without a licence key, and runs on Linux.
quote: On Nov 11, 2024, Broadcom announced that VMware Desktop Hypervisor (VMware Fusion Pro & VMware Workstation Pro) is available free for Commercial, Educational, and Personal users.

claim: On a muxless Optimus laptop, dGPU passthrough caps guest resolution at 640x480, NVIDIA drivers will not form Optimus with a virtual iGPU, and setup requires custom UEFI, vBIOS extraction and ACPI patching.
quote: the resolution will be limited to 640x480, and you will have to rely on remote desktop software ... GVT-g iGPU and NVIDIA dGPU cannot form Optimus configuration, NVIDIA drivers won't move game workloads to dGPU

claim: Bottles is the mainstream GUI for managing Wine prefixes for non-game Windows applications.
Visual Studio 2022 cannot be run usefully under Wine; even if installed it works very poorly with large amounts of missing functionality.
quote: Visual Studio is Windows only, and Wine cannot handle it currently.

claim: A Windows licence covers one instance on one device, physical or virtual; additional virtual instances require additional licences.
quote: a single license allows you to install only one instance of the software for use on one device, whether that device is physical or virtual

claim: SSMS 20 runs under Wine 11 with patches: connect, Object Explorer, Query Editor and Server Properties work, while Azure connection types, SSAS/SSRS/SSIS designers, Always On dialogs and the Tuning Advisor do not.
quote: connect, Object Explorer tree, Query Editor, Server Properties, Database Mail, most menus and dialogs ... Azure connection types, SSAS/SSRS/SSIS designers, Always On dialogs, Database Engine Tuning Advisor

claim: WinApps uses FreeRDP to render Windows applications from a VM or remote Windows box as seamless windows alongside Linux apps.
quote: uses FreeRDP as a backend to seamlessly render Windows applications alongside GNU/Linux applications

claim: Microsoft cut Windows 365 Cloud PC prices by 20% on 1 May 2026, to $28-56 per user per month, excluding Microsoft 365 productivity apps.
quote: Microsoft cut the price of Windows 365 Cloud PCs by 20% on May 1, 2026, with new rates of $28 to $56 per user per month, down from $35 to $70.

claim: Fall Guys is rated Running (not Supported) and requires Proton GE or Experimental; 55% of the 1,166 tracked anti-cheat games are broken on Linux.
quote: Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout ... status of Running ... uses Easy Anti-Cheat ... Requires Proton GE or Proton Experimental. 642 Broken (55%)

claim: Lutris is the game-oriented Wine/Proton runner and prefix manager.
CrossOver+ costs $74, renews at $34/yr for continued support and updates, and CrossOver Life is $494.
quote: CrossOver+ costs $74 USD, while CrossOver Life (lifetime version) is $494 ... You can renew CrossOver for $34 USD a year

claim: Clipboard and folder sharing with a Windows guest requires manually installing SPICE guest tools, plus phodav/spice-webdavd in the guest for guest-to-host file sharing.
quote: For Windows guests, you do need to download and install SPICE manually ... to share files from guest to host you will need to install phodav (or spice-webdavd) and reboot your VM

claim: A Lenovo Legion 5 Pro RTX 3060M passthrough attempt initialised video but Windows did not recognise the device as RTX 3060 hardware and NVIDIA's drivers refused it.
quote: A notebook's discrete GPU differs a lot from a desktop GPU, making it difficult or impossible to pass it through to a VM.

claim: virtio-gpu 3D acceleration is mature for Linux guests, while a fully functional OpenGL/Direct3D driver for Windows guests is still work in progress.
quote: there's currently an active work in progress on a fully functional OpenGL and Direct3D10 driver
